intro.heading: Mapping Angin Nauli
intro.subheading: A cartographic collection by our team
paragraphs: This atlas brings together four thematic maps built from field surveys, satellite imagery, and geospatial analysis. Together, they offer a layered view of Angin Nauli's terrain, land cover, living landscape, and landslide risk.
Browse the optimized previews for a quick overview, then open the original PDF when you need to inspect the full legend, coordinate grid, scale, or fine map details.

maps.title: Slope Analysis
maps.description: A terrain classification showing slope gradients from 0-8% through areas steeper than 45%. The map makes the sharp transition from the lower settled edge to Angin Nauli's steep interior immediately visible.
maps.imageAlt: Thematic slope-gradient map of Angin Nauli with five slope classes

maps.title: Land Use
maps.description: A land-use interpretation of Angin Nauli grouped into settlement, vegetation, and open soil. It highlights the dense vegetated interior and the pattern of developed areas along the southern and western edges.
maps.imageAlt: Land-use map of Angin Nauli showing settlement, vegetation, and open soil

maps.title: Flora Distribution
maps.description: A field inventory plotting the observed distribution of eleven flora types, including pine, ketapang, coconut, cacao, breadfruit, waru, areca palm, rubber, mahogany, acacia, and teak across Angin Nauli.
maps.imageAlt: Flora distribution map of Angin Nauli with field observations and species photographs

maps.title: Landslide Points
maps.description: A field-survey map showing four documented landslide points across Angin Nauli, with photographs and locations over satellite imagery. It connects the mapped terrain to places where slope movement has been recorded.
maps.imageAlt: Landslide point distribution map of Angin Nauli with four field photographs
